4.3.title: 4.3 Spam
4.3.text: Don't submit near-duplicate apps, or apps whose metadata is stuffed with keywords to game search ranking.

2.1.title: 2.1 App Completeness
2.1.text: Apps that crash, exhibit obvious bugs, or contain broken links will be rejected.

5.1.1.title: 5.1.1 Data Collection and Storage
5.1.1.text: Apps must have a privacy manifest that accurately declares use of required-reason APIs and the data they collect.

2.5.6.title: 2.5.6 Software Requirements (Accessory/Hardware Use)
2.5.6.text: Apps that use hardware/accessory frameworks (Bluetooth, HomeKit, etc.) must declare a usage-description string explaining why.

1.2.title: 1.2 User-Generated Content
1.2.text: Apps with user-generated content must include a method for filtering objectionable material, a mechanism to report offensive content, and the ability to block abusive users.
